name: Carlos Cabrera
profileSummary: Carlos Rodrigo Cabrera is a Colombian former newsman and professional wrestling commentator signed to All Elite Wrestling. He is best known for his time with WWE, where he was one half of the company's Spanish announce team in which he is the play-by-play announcer. His longtime broadcast partner was the Ecuadorian former professional wrestler Hugo Savinovich, who was the color commentator on the announce team until October 2011. Then, his partner was Marcelo Rodriguez until 2022.
